text: Twenty-one forty. [pause] A storm rolls over the park.
Lightning strikes a pole. [pause] The power goes out.
And with it… the electric fence.
Fifty metres. [pause] Something moves between the trees.
Forget the movies. [pause] A real Velociraptor was about the size of a turkey, and covered in feathers.
But its bigger cousin, Utahraptor, could weigh as much as a horse.
And animals like these may have hunted in groups.
The last keepers hurry away and lock the gates behind them.
But on the far side of the park, another gate has swung open. [pause] And the biggest hunter of them all just walked through it.
